name: progressive-image-loading
title: Progressive Image Loading
description: Progressive Image Loading is a React image component that holds the image's space and shows a placeholder until the file arrives, then develops it in from a soft blur to full sharpness. The placeholder can be a BlurHash string, decoded in the component with no package, or a tiny preview image, both blurred and overscaled so their edges never show, a flat fill in the photo's main color, which a BlurHash also provides, or a neutral shimmer. The frame takes its aspect ratio from ratio or from width and height, so the layout never shifts. Images already in the cache appear at once, a failed load shows a quiet error state with the alt text, and reduced motion swaps in the image with a short fade. It lazy loads by default and can render through next/image or any other image component.
author: Wensity <hey@wensity.com>
